high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "meghaaarao_," who posted it 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a black-and-white sketch of two figures embracing each other. The figures appear to be nude, with one figure's head resting on the other's shoulder, suggesting a tender or intimate moment. The sketch is done in a loose, expressive style, with heavy use of shading and smudges that give it a somewhat abstract feel. The background of the sketch is plain white, which helps to emphasize the figures and their interaction.
